about: The four part makers of Overdrive Frame. Each builds in its own style on purpose, so a mech mixing makers looks patched together. colours = the factory paint (primary, secondary, accent) and the colour its lights glow.

makers.name: Celerity Works
makers.lookText: Sleek and angular: knife-edge plates, swept fins, a narrow waist and glowing seams.
makers.leaning: Speed and energy weapons. Light frames, strong boosters, lasers and rail guns; thin armour that shrugs off energy hits.

makers.name: Brannoch Heavy Industries
makers.lookText: Chunky and industrial: slab armour, bolted plates, hydraulic rams, hazard stripes and exhaust stacks.
makers.leaning: Armour and kinetic or explosive firepower. Heavy frames with big carry limits; slow, hard to stagger.

makers.name: Calyx Biomechanics
makers.lookText: Rounded and organic: smooth shells, segmented limbs, ring joints and soft glowing pods.
makers.leaning: Endurance and odd technology. Big generators, cool running, shields, repair beams, chain lightning and hover legs.

makers.name: Patchwork Salvage
makers.lookText: Cheap and scrap-built: mismatched plates, exposed pipes, roll cages and welded patches.
makers.leaning: Cheap, light and hot-running. Fire, mines, turrets and swarms of small hits; low armour, odd tricks.
